stem:
A toy is made up of cylindrical rings stacked on a base, as shown in the diagram. The diameter of Ring 1 is 87% of the diameter of the base. For Ring 2 through Ring 7, the diameter of each ring is 87% of the diameter of the ring directly below it.

The diameter of the base is 5 inches. Which function can be used to find the diameter in inches of Ring r, where 1 \( \leq r \leq \) 7?
